verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows n8n has error-workflow handling and execution history/search, but contains no documentation or community evidence about wait/pause nodes persisting state across worker or platform restarts for long-lived (multi-day) workflows. Missing for 10: docs on the Wait node's persistence mechanism, evidence of durable execution state across restarts, and any confirmation (vendor or hands-on) that long-running waits survive crashes/upgrades.
